design: One fresh hosted CLI call per requested configuration, same six cases in one prompt. Three initially correct and three defective tables. Tasks share a context; per-configuration timing is a single observation. Elapsed duration includes CLI startup and network; cache-hit tokens and reasoning tokens are components of input and output. Missing task outcomes retain their observed denominators. Model and reasoning effort are requested settings; server execution is not attested. This panel measures functionality. Wall-clock seconds are not a price or a measure of local model compute.
